content_of_post_to_comment: What are some cover versions of songs that are better than the original? I was listening to Weezer’s cover version of ‘You Might Think’ and The Cars’ original back to back and the original version is clearly superior as most original versions tend to be when compared to a cover. But then I got to thinking about cover versions of songs that were better than the original versions, and the only one I could think of off the tops of my head was Jimi Hendrix’s cover of Dylan’s ‘All Along The Watchtower.’
comment: Maybe the best covers don't improve the original so much as reveal what was latent in it. Dylan's version feels like a warning; Hendrix turns it into an apocalypse. Same song, entirely different scale of consequence.
